newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down,investors keep to sidelines.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down,investors keep to sidelines.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended soft as small investors, short of funding, kept to the sidelines.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 52.03 points or 1.69 percent at 3,012.96. Of 110 traded issues, 28 gained and 82 lost.

"There was selling pressure although the government lifted the ban on lending by commercial banks against shares on Saturday. The investors need time, and many of them were seen booking profit from Saturday's gain," said broker M. Morshed.
Singer Bangladesh gained 825 taka to 17,549 and Shine Pukur lost 37 taka to 716.
